description: This file defines the PHP class `Cheque` in the namespace `Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Payment`. It implements a payment method controller for Cheque payments in OpenCart, including methods `index()` to display checkout information and `confirm()` to process the payment confirmation.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Controller class for handling cheque payment method in OpenCart

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and displays the cheque payment information page during checkout

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes the payment confirmation, records order status, and returns a JSON response for checkout
